name: Xenagos, god of revels
description: A god of revels who considers what mortals' beliefs say about godhood.

description_citations.text: Battlebond: card flavor text (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xenagos muses that the gods of Theros are born of mortals' beliefs and what that says of his own godhood.
timeline.quote: "The gods of Theros are born of the expectations and beliefs of mortals.
